chunks: When the two (angels) who keep the account, one sitting on the right, one on the left, take it down,

key_terms.الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ: The two receivers (angels who record deeds)

ai.seo_question: Who are the two angels recording deeds on the right and left?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to signify the continuous, simultaneous recording of deeds by two angels, emphasizing the precision of divine knowledge. The term 'qa'idun' (seated) suggests their attentive and stationary presence, ensuring no action escapes notice. This serves as a reminder for believers to maintain mindfulness (muraqabah) of their actions throughout daily life.
